cond_0001.intro: We are looking for an experienced Senior Manufacturing and Process Engineer to join our team at [Company name masked] in [Location masked]. This role provides daily support to Brewing, Packaging, Operations and Maintenance to ensure all aspects of production are operating correctly and efficiently. You will lead manufacturing and process improvement initiatives from development through implementation to increase productivity, capacity, quality, and safety, and ensure compliance. Project management responsibilities include sourcing, commissioning, building and installing equipment and working with relevant internal and external partners. This position suits someone comfortable working in a sometimes unstructured environment and willing to support all aspects of the business.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Develop, implement and manage a lean manufacturing engineering program across all operations.
Collaborate with the brewery leadership team to identify, develop and lead process improvement and engineering initiatives to increase efficiency, safety, quality and productivity.
Establish and maintain supporting infrastructure, MRO process, inventory, vendor relationships, documentation systems and preventative maintenance capabilities.
Prepare project scopes, capital cost estimates, cost value analyses, and collaborate with relevant parties, including Finance, to strategize, plan and deploy capital effectively.
Develop schedules, work break down structures, deliverables, budget and resource plans.
Manage and execute projects, on schedule and within budget across the entire lifecycle (install, commission, controls, instrumentation, SCADA/MES/ERP).
Manage and supervise related contract work schedules, quality, and performance.
Implement robust PM, PdM, and MOH maintenance plans for all new equipment overseen.
Drive the part, machine and operator proficiency and consistency of the production lines to minimize shift and production variance.
Apply various programming languages necessary for utilizing the SCADA system including programming PLCs (programmable logic controllers) and the interface software (Ignition).
Develop/review technical documents (e.g., blueprints, schematics, P&IDs, etc.)
Assist Production and Maintenance Departments in repairing technical problems during production operations.
Effectively manage multiple projects and work independently with minimal supervision.
Assist in achieving department KPIs, business and production goals.
Over time, develop standardized programs, KPIs/metrics and reports to ensure process operating performance, ongoing improvements, risk identification, visibility and training.
Develop operational performance dashboards to report on health of the systems.
Drive and/or support the planning and execution of reviews and present in key forums to support the above.
Troubleshoot systems as required.
Perform failure analysis and implement preventive methods to improve performance.
Ensure alarms and controls identify and resolve issues systemically.
Raise maintenance team skillset, workflow and competency.
Mentor/coach employees within the department related to improvements or projects.
Seek out all opportunities to improve capacity, eliminate waste, improve sustainability and heighten team safety, comradery and fun.
Occasional travel required to support projects.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial or Manufacturing Engineering.
8+ Years of experience in beverage manufacturing, brewing or related process industries.
Demonstrated results in developing and deploying CAPEX projects — managing complex engineering projects and large capital budgets in a manufacturing environment.
Proficiency in engineering and reliability toolsets: CAD, SCADA (Ignition preferred), PLCs, controls hardware, Pareto analysis, Failure Modes and Effects Analysis (FMEA), Reliability Centered Maintenance (RCM), and Root Cause Analysis (RCA).
Experience with CMMS, ERP, MES production and inventory management systems.
Proficiency with project management tools including AutoCAD, Microsoft Project.
Deep understanding of lean manufacturing.
Financial acumen and proficiency with CAPEX budgeting and reporting.
Strong communicator with solid presentation skills.
Self-starter able to juggle multiple projects, prioritize, and execute with minimal supervision.
Preferred Requirements
Experience with brewhouse, cellar and packaging equipment.
PMP certification, PMI equivalent credential/training, and blackbelt or greenbelt certification.
Big picture thinker, strategic and able to distill tactical/detailed process and workflows.
Entrepreneurial mindset with attention to detail.
Physical Requirements & Working Conditions:
This position will require time shared between an office and Brewery/Manufacturing plant environment. Working conditions may include loud noises, extreme temperatures, enclosed spaces. Must wear Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) including safety glasses, hair nets, ear plugs and steel toe boots (as required by company policy).
cond_0001.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.

Collaborate with the brewery leadership team to identify, develop and lead process improvement and engineering initiatives to increase efficiency, safety, quality and productivity.
Establish and maintain supporting infrastructure, MRO process, inventory, vendor relationships, documentation systems and preventative maintenance capabilities.
Prepare project scopes, capital cost estimates, cost value analyses, and collaborate with relevant parties, including Finance, to strategize, plan and deploy capital effectively.
Develop schedules, work break down structures, deliverables, budget and resource plans.
Manage and execute projects, on schedule and within budget across the entire lifecycle (install, commission, controls, instrumentation, SCADA/MES/ERP).
Manage and supervise related contract work schedules, quality, and performance.
Implement robust PM, PdM, and MOH maintenance plans for all new equipment overseen.
Drive the part, machine and operator proficiency and consistency of the production lines to minimize shift and production variance.
Apply various programming languages necessary for utilizing the SCADA system including programming PLCs (programmable logic controllers) and the interface software (Ignition).
Develop/review technical documents (e.g., blueprints, schematics, P&IDs, etc.)
Assist Production and Maintenance Departments in repairing technical problems during production operations.
Effectively manage multiple projects and work independently with minimal supervision.
Assist in achieving department KPIs, business and production goals.
Over time, develop standardized programs, KPIs/metrics and reports to ensure process operating performance, ongoing improvements, risk identification, visibility and training.
Develop operational performance dashboards to report on health of the systems.
Drive and/or support the planning and execution of reviews and present in key forums to support the above.
Troubleshoot systems as required.
Perform failure analysis and implement preventive methods to improve performance.
Ensure alarms and controls identify and resolve issues systemically.
Raise maintenance team skillset, workflow and competency.
Mentor/coach employees within the department related to improvements or projects.
Seek out all opportunities to improve capacity, eliminate waste, improve sustainability and heighten team safety, comradery and fun.
Occasional travel required to support projects.
cond_0055.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial or Manufacturing Engineering.
8+ Years of experience in beverage manufacturing, brewing or related process industries.
Demonstrated results in developing and deploying CAPEX projects — managing complex engineering projects and large capital budgets in a manufacturing environment.
Proficiency in engineering and reliability toolsets: CAD, SCADA (Ignition preferred), PLCs, controls hardware, Pareto analysis, Failure Modes and Effects Analysis (FMEA), Reliability Centered Maintenance (RCM), and Root Cause Analysis (RCA).
Experience with CMMS, ERP, MES production and inventory management systems.
Proficiency with project management tools including AutoCAD, Microsoft Project.
Deep understanding of lean manufacturing.
Financial acumen and proficiency with CAPEX budgeting and reporting.
Strong communicator with solid presentation skills.
Self-starter able to juggle multiple projects, prioritize, and execute with minimal supervision.
Preferred Requirements
Experience with brewhouse, cellar and packaging equipment.
PMP certification, PMI equivalent credential/training, and blackbelt or greenbelt certification.
Big picture thinker, strategic and able to distill tactical/detailed process and workflows.
Entrepreneurial mindset with attention to detail.
Physical Requirements & Working Conditions:
This position will require time shared between an office and Brewery/Manufacturing plant environment. Working conditions may include loud noises, extreme temperatures, enclosed spaces. Must wear Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) including safety glasses, hair nets, ear plugs and steel toe boots (as required by company policy).

Develop, implement and manage a lean manufacturing engineering program across all operations. Collaborate with the brewery leadership team to identify, develop and lead process improvement and engineering initiatives to increase efficiency, safety, quality and productivity. Establish and maintain supporting infrastructure, MRO process, inventory, vendor relationships, documentation systems and preventative maintenance capabilities. Prepare project scopes, capital cost estimates, cost value analyses, and collaborate with relevant parties, including Finance, to strategize, plan and deploy capital effectively. Develop schedules, work break down structures, deliverables, budget and resource plans. Manage and execute projects, on schedule and within budget across the entire lifecycle (install, commission, controls, instrumentation, SCADA/MES/ERP). Manage and supervise related contract work schedules, quality, and performance. Implement robust PM, PdM, and MOH maintenance plans for all new equipment overseen. Drive the part, machine and operator proficiency and consistency of the production lines to minimize shift and production variance. Apply various programming languages necessary for utilizing the SCADA system including programming PLCs (programmable logic controllers) and the interface software (Ignition). Develop/review technical documents (e.g., blueprints, schematics, P&IDs, etc.) Assist Production and Maintenance Departments in repairing technical problems during production operations. Effectively manage multiple projects and work independently with minimal supervision. Assist in achieving department KPIs, business and production goals. Over time, develop standardized programs, KPIs/metrics and reports to ensure process operating performance, ongoing improvements, risk identification, visibility and training. Develop operational performance dashboards to report on health of the systems. Drive and/or support the planning and execution of reviews and present in key forums to support the above. Troubleshoot systems as required. Perform failure analysis and implement preventive methods to improve performance. Ensure alarms and controls identify and resolve issues systemically. Raise maintenance team skillset, workflow and competency. Mentor/coach employees within the department related to improvements or projects. Seek out all opportunities to improve capacity, eliminate waste, improve sustainability and heighten team safety, comradery and fun. Occasional travel required to support projects.
cond_0112.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial or Manufacturing Engineering.
8+ Years of experience in beverage manufacturing, brewing or related process industries.
Demonstrated results in developing and deploying CAPEX projects — managing complex engineering projects and large capital budgets in a manufacturing environment.
Proficiency in engineering and reliability toolsets — CAD, SCADA (Ignition preferred), PLCs, controls hardware, Pareto analysis, Failure Modes and Effects Analysis (FMEA), Reliability Centered Maintenance (RCM), and Root Cause Analysis (RCA).
Experience with CMMS, ERP, MES production and inventory management systems.
Deep understanding of lean manufacturing.
Financial acumen and proficiency with CAPEX budgeting and reporting.
Must be a self-starter with the ability to juggle multiple projects, prioritize, and execute.
An effective and persuasive communicator with outstanding presence and presentation skills.
Preferred Requirements
Experience with brewhouse, cellar and packaging equipment.
Proficiency with project management tools including AutoCAD, Microsoft Project.
PMP certification, PMI equivalent credential/training and blackbelt or greenbelt certification.
Entrepreneurial, astute, has a passion for getting into the details.
Big picture thinker, strategic and able to distill tactical/detailed process and workflows.
Physical Requirements & Working Conditions:
This position will require time shared between an office and Brewery/Manufacturing plant environment. Working conditions may include loud noises, extreme temperatures, enclosed spaces. Must wear Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) including safety glasses, hair nets, ear plugs and steel toe boots (as required by company policy).

cond_0148.intro:
Join a celebrated legacy brewery with an entrepreneurial spirit. We are growing and looking for an experienced Manufacturing Engineer and change agent to join our enthusiastic crew in [Location masked].
The Senior Manufacturing and Process Engineer is a key member of the Brewery Operations leadership team. In this role you will provide daily support to Brewing, Packaging, Operations and Maintenance to ensure all aspects of production are operating correctly and efficiently. You will lead manufacturing and process improvement initiatives from development through implementation to increase productivity, capacity, improve quality, safety and ensure compliance. Project management responsibilities will include sourcing, commissioning, building and installing equipment and working with relevant internal and external partners. This position is ideal for someone who is comfortable working in a dynamic, sometimes unstructured start-up environment, who is willing to roll up their sleeves and support all aspects of the business. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of brewing and manufacturing processes.
cond_0148.responsibilities:
Essential duties and responsibilities include the following. Other duties may be assigned.
Develop, implement and manage a lean manufacturing engineering program across all operations. Collaborate with the brewery leadership team to identify, develop and lead process improvement and engineering initiatives to increase efficiency, safety, quality and productivity. Establish and maintain supporting infrastructure, MRO process, inventory, vendor relationships, documentation systems and preventative maintenance capabilities. Prepare project scopes, capital cost estimates, cost value analyses, and collaborate with relevant parties, including Finance, to strategize, plan and deploy capital effectively. Develop schedules, work break down structures, deliverables, budget and resource plans. Manage and execute projects, on schedule and within budget across the entire lifecycle (install, commission, controls, instrumentation, SCADA/MES/ERP). Manage and supervise related contract work schedules, quality, and performance. Implement robust PM, PdM, and MOH maintenance plans for all new equipment overseen. Drive the part, machine and operator proficiency and consistency of the production lines to minimize shift and production variance. Apply various programming languages necessary for utilizing the SCADA system including programming PLCs (programmable logic controllers) and the interface software (Ignition). Develop/review technical documents (e.g., blueprints, schematics, P&IDs, etc.) Assist Production and Maintenance Departments in repairing technical problems during production operations. Effectively manage multiple projects and work independently with minimal supervision. Assist in achieving department KPIs, business and production goals. Over time, develop standardized programs, KPIs/metrics and reports to ensure process operating performance, ongoing improvements, risk identification, visibility and training. Develop operational performance dashboards to report on health of the systems. Drive and/or support the planning and execution of reviews and present in key forums to support the above. Troubleshoot systems as required. Perform failure analysis and implement preventive methods to improve performance. Ensure alarms and controls identify and resolve issues systemically. Raise maintenance team skillset, workflow and competency. Mentor/coach employees within the department related to improvements or projects. Seek out all opportunities to improve capacity, eliminate waste, improve sustainability and heighten team safety, comradery and fun. Occasional travel required to support projects.
cond_0148.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial or Manufacturing Engineering.
8+ Years of experience in beverage manufacturing, brewing or related process industries.
Demonstrated results in developing and deploying CAPEX projects — managing complex engineering projects and large capital budgets in a manufacturing environment.
Proficiency in engineering and reliability toolsets — CAD, SCADA (Ignition preferred), PLCs, controls hardware, Pareto analysis, Failure Modes and Effects Analysis (FMEA), Reliability Centered Maintenance (RCM), and Root Cause Analysis (RCA).
Experience with CMMS, ERP, MES production and inventory management systems.
Deep understanding of lean manufacturing.
Financial acumen and proficiency with CAPEX budgeting and reporting.
Must be a self-starter with the ability to juggle multiple projects, prioritize, and execute.
An effective and persuasive communicator with outstanding presence and presentation skills.
Preferred Requirements
Experience with brewhouse, cellar and packaging equipment.
Proficiency with project management tools including AutoCAD, Microsoft Project.
PMP certification, PMI equivalent credential/training and blackbelt or greenbelt certification.
Entrepreneurial, astute, has a passion for getting into the details.
Big picture thinker, strategic and able to distill tactical/detailed process and workflows.
Physical Requirements & Working Conditions:
This position will require time shared between an office and Brewery/Manufacturing plant environment. Working conditions may include loud noises, extreme temperatures, enclosed spaces. Must wear Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) including safety glasses, hair nets, ear plugs and steel toe boots (as required by company policy).

cond_0168.intro: We are looking for a Senior Manufacturing and Process Engineer to join our team at [Company name masked] in [Location masked]. In this role you will provide daily support to Brewing, Packaging, Operations and Maintenance to keep all aspects of production running correctly and efficiently. You will regularly connect with the brewery leadership team and work closely with internal and external partners to lead manufacturing and process improvement initiatives from development through implementation, covering productivity, capacity, quality, safety, and compliance. This position suits someone comfortable in a sometimes unstructured environment who is willing to roll up their sleeves and stay actively engaged across all parts of the business.
cond_0168.responsibilities:
Develop, implement, and manage a lean manufacturing engineering program across all operations.
Regularly collaborate with the brewery leadership team to identify, develop, and lead process improvement and engineering initiatives to increase efficiency, safety, quality, and productivity.
Establish and maintain supporting infrastructure, MRO process, inventory, vendor relationships, documentation systems, and preventative maintenance capabilities.
Prepare project scopes, capital cost estimates, and cost value analyses, and stay in close contact with Finance and other relevant parties to strategize, plan, and deploy capital effectively.
Develop schedules, work breakdown structures, deliverables, budgets, and resource plans.
Manage and execute projects on schedule and within budget across the entire lifecycle (install, commission, controls, instrumentation, SCADA/MES/ERP).
Manage and supervise related contract work schedules, quality, and performance.
Implement robust PM, PdM, and MOH maintenance plans for all new equipment overseen.
Drive part, machine, and operator proficiency and consistency of the production lines to minimize shift and production variance.
Apply various programming languages for the SCADA system, including programming PLCs and the interface software (Ignition).
Develop and review technical documents (e.g., blueprints, schematics, P&IDs).
Work directly with Production and Maintenance teams to troubleshoot and resolve technical problems during production operations.
Manage multiple projects and communicate progress clearly to relevant stakeholders.
Assist in achieving department KPIs, business, and production goals.
Over time, develop standardized programs, KPIs/metrics, and reports to ensure process operating performance, ongoing improvements, risk identification, visibility, and training.
Develop operational performance dashboards and actively present findings in key forums to keep teams informed on system health.
Troubleshoot systems as required; perform failure analysis and implement preventive methods to improve performance.
Ensure alarms and controls identify and resolve issues systemically.
Raise maintenance team skillset, workflow, and competency through regular coaching and mentoring.
Seek out opportunities to improve capacity, eliminate waste, improve sustainability, and heighten team safety, camaraderie, and fun.
Occasional travel required to support projects.
cond_0168.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, or Manufacturing Engineering.
8+ Years of experience in beverage manufacturing, brewing, or related process industries.
Demonstrated results developing and deploying CAPEX projects, managing complex engineering projects and large capital budgets in a manufacturing environment.
Proficiency in engineering and reliability toolsets: CAD, SCADA (Ignition preferred), PLCs, controls hardware, Pareto analysis, FMEA, RCM, and RCA.
Experience with CMMS, ERP, and MES production and inventory management systems.
Proficiency with project management tools including AutoCAD and Microsoft Project.
Deep understanding of lean manufacturing.
Financial acumen and proficiency with CAPEX budgeting and reporting.
Strong communicator who is comfortable explaining trade-offs, walking stakeholders through decisions, and handling questions directly.
Preferred Requirements
Experience with brewhouse, cellar, and packaging equipment.
PMP certification, PMI equivalent credential/training, and blackbelt or greenbelt certification.
Big-picture thinker who can also get into the details of tactical processes and workflows.
Able to manage multiple projects, prioritize, and stay in regular contact with teams across a busy, varied workload.

This position is ideal for someone who is comfortable working in a dynamic, sometimes unstructured start-up environment, who is willing to roll up their sleeves and support all aspects of the business. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of manufacturing processes and engineering systems.
cond_0175.responsibilities:
Develop, implement and manage a lean manufacturing engineering program across all operations.
Collaborate with the brewery leadership team to identify, develop and lead process improvement and engineering initiatives to increase efficiency, safety, quality and productivity.
Establish and maintain supporting infrastructure, MRO process, inventory, vendor relationships, documentation systems and preventative maintenance capabilities.
Prepare project scopes, capital cost estimates, cost value analyses, and collaborate with relevant parties, including Finance, to strategize, plan and deploy capital effectively.
Develop schedules, work break down structures, deliverables, budget and resource plans.
Manage and execute projects, on schedule and within budget across the entire lifecycle (install, commission, controls, instrumentation, SCADA/MES/ERP).
Manage and supervise related contract work schedules, quality, and performance.
Implement robust PM, PdM, and MOH maintenance plans for all new equipment overseen.
Drive the part, machine and operator proficiency and consistency of the production lines to minimize shift and production variance.
Apply various programming languages necessary for utilizing the SCADA system including programming PLCs (programmable logic controllers) and the interface software (Ignition).
Develop/review technical documents (e.g., blueprints, schematics, P&IDs, etc.)
Assist Production and Maintenance Departments in repairing technical problems during production operations.
Effectively manage multiple projects and work independently with minimal supervision.
Assist in achieving department KPIs, business and production goals.
Over time, develop standardized programs, KPIs/metrics and reports to ensure process operating performance, ongoing improvements, risk identification, visibility and training.
Develop operational performance dashboards to report on health of the systems.
Drive and/or support the planning and execution of reviews and present in key forums to support the above.
Troubleshoot systems as required.
Perform failure analysis and implement preventive methods to improve performance.
Ensure alarms and controls identify and resolve issues systemically.
Raise maintenance team skillset, workflow and competency.
Mentor/coach employees within the department related to improvements or projects.
Seek out all opportunities to improve capacity, eliminate waste, improve sustainability and heighten team safety, comradery and fun.
Occasional travel required to support projects.
cond_0175.requirements:
Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial or Manufacturing Engineering.
8+ Years of experience in beverage manufacturing, brewing or related process industries.
Experience with brewhouse, cellar and packaging equipment is preferred.
Demonstrated results in developing and deploying CAPEX projects- managing complex engineering projects and large capital budgets in a manufacturing environment.
Proficiency in engineering and reliability toolsets- CAD, SCADA (Ignition preferred), PLCs, controls hardware, Pareto analysis, Failure Modes and Effects Analysis (FMEA), Reliability Centered Maintenance (RCM), and Root Cause Analysis (RCA).
Experience with CMMS, ERP, MES production and inventory management systems.
Proficiency with project management tools including AutoCAD, Microsoft Project.
Deep understanding of lean manufacturing.
PMP certification, PMI equivalent credential/training and blackbelt or greenbelt certification desired.
Financial acumen and proficiency with CAPEX budgeting and reporting.
Entrepreneurial, astute, has a passion for getting into the details.
Big picture thinker, strategic and able to distill tactical/detailed process and workflows.
Must be a self-starter with the ability to juggle multiple projects, prioritize, and execute.
An effective and persuasive communicator with outstanding presence and presentation skills.
This position will require time shared between an office and Brewery/Manufacturing plant environment. Working conditions may include loud noises, extreme temperatures, enclosed spaces. Must wear Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) including safety glasses, hair nets, ear plugs and steel toe boots (as required by company policy).

cond_0234.intro: We are looking for a Senior Manufacturing and Process Engineer to join our team at [Company name masked] in [Location masked]. You will work alongside the Brewery Operations leadership team, supporting Brewing, Packaging, Operations and Maintenance to help keep all aspects of production running correctly and efficiently. This role suits someone comfortable in a sometimes unstructured environment who is willing to roll up their sleeves and contribute across the business.
cond_0234.responsibilities:
Develop, implement and manage a lean manufacturing engineering program across all operations.
Coordinate with the brewery leadership team to identify, develop and advance process improvement and engineering initiatives to increase efficiency, safety, quality and productivity.
Establish and maintain supporting infrastructure, MRO process, inventory, vendor relationships, documentation systems and preventative maintenance capabilities.
Prepare project scopes, capital cost estimates, and cost value analyses, and work with relevant parties, including Finance, to plan and deploy capital effectively.
Develop schedules, work breakdown structures, deliverables, budget and resource plans.
Coordinate and execute projects on schedule and within budget across the entire lifecycle (install, commission, controls, instrumentation, SCADA/MES/ERP).
Oversee related contract work schedules, quality, and performance in coordination with contractors and internal stakeholders.
Implement robust PM, PdM, and MOH maintenance plans for all new equipment overseen.
Work with production teams to improve part, machine and operator consistency across production lines to minimize shift and production variance.
Apply various programming languages necessary for utilizing the SCADA system including programming PLCs (programmable logic controllers) and the interface software (Ignition).
Develop and review technical documents (e.g., blueprints, schematics, P&IDs, etc.).
Support Production and Maintenance Departments in resolving technical problems during production operations.
Help achieve department KPIs, business and production goals.
Over time, develop standardized programs, KPIs/metrics and reports to ensure process operating performance, ongoing improvements, risk identification, visibility and training.
Develop operational performance dashboards to report on health of the systems.
Coordinate the planning and execution of reviews and present findings in key forums to support the above.
Troubleshoot systems as required.
Perform failure analysis and work with the team to implement preventive methods to improve performance.
Ensure alarms and controls identify and resolve issues systemically.
Help raise maintenance team skillset, workflow and competency.
Mentor and coach employees within the department on improvements or projects.
Work with the broader team to identify opportunities to improve capacity, eliminate waste, improve sustainability and heighten team safety.
Occasional travel required to support projects.

cond_0261.intro: We are looking for a Senior Manufacturing and Process Engineer to join our team at [Company name masked] in [Location masked]. In this role, you will work alongside the Brewery Operations leadership team, supporting Brewing, Packaging, Operations, and Maintenance to help keep all aspects of production running correctly and efficiently. You will coordinate with internal and external partners on manufacturing and process improvement initiatives — from development through implementation — to increase productivity, capacity, quality, and safety, and to help ensure compliance. This position suits someone comfortable working in a sometimes unstructured environment and willing to pitch in across all areas of the business.
cond_0261.responsibilities:
Essential duties and responsibilities include the following. Other duties may be assigned.
Work with the brewery leadership team to identify, develop, and carry out process improvement and engineering initiatives that increase efficiency, safety, quality, and productivity.
Coordinate with relevant internal and external partners, including Finance, to prepare project scopes, capital cost estimates, and cost-value analyses, and to plan and deploy capital effectively.
Develop and maintain a lean manufacturing engineering program across all operations.
Establish and maintain supporting infrastructure, MRO processes, inventory, vendor relationships, documentation systems, and preventative maintenance capabilities.
Develop schedules, work breakdown structures, deliverables, budgets, and resource plans in coordination with stakeholders.
Work with cross-functional partners to manage and execute projects on schedule and within budget across the full lifecycle (install, commission, controls, instrumentation, SCADA/MES/ERP).
Coordinate and oversee related contract work schedules, quality, and performance.
Implement PM, PdM, and MOH maintenance plans for all new equipment in collaboration with the maintenance team.
Work alongside production teams to improve part, machine, and operator consistency on production lines and reduce shift and production variance.
Apply programming languages needed for the SCADA system, including PLC programming and interface software (Ignition).
Develop and review technical documents (e.g., blueprints, schematics, P&IDs).
Support the Production and Maintenance Departments in resolving technical problems during production operations.
Coordinate across multiple projects and help teams stay aligned on priorities and progress.
Contribute to department KPIs, business goals, and production targets.
Over time, help build standardized programs, KPIs/metrics, and reports to track process performance, support ongoing improvements, identify risks, and enable training.
Develop operational performance dashboards to report on system health, and share findings in key forums.
Troubleshoot systems as needed; perform failure analysis and implement preventive methods to improve performance.
Help ensure alarms and controls identify and resolve issues systematically.
Support the maintenance team in building skillset, workflow, and competency; mentor and coach team members on improvements and projects.
Work with the broader team to identify opportunities to improve capacity, reduce waste, improve sustainability, and strengthen team safety.
Occasional travel required to support projects.
cond_0261.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, or Manufacturing Engineering.
8+ Years of experience in beverage manufacturing, brewing, or related process industries.
Demonstrated results developing and deploying CAPEX projects, managing complex engineering projects and large capital budgets in a manufacturing environment.
Proficiency in engineering and reliability toolsets: CAD, SCADA (Ignition preferred), PLCs, controls hardware, Pareto analysis, FMEA, RCM, and RCA.
Experience with CMMS, ERP, and MES production and inventory management systems.
Proficiency with project management tools including AutoCAD and Microsoft Project.
Solid understanding of lean manufacturing.
Financial acumen and proficiency with CAPEX budgeting and reporting.
Ability to manage multiple projects, prioritize, and execute with minimal supervision.
Effective communicator with strong presentation skills.
Preferred Requirements
Experience with brewhouse, cellar, and packaging equipment.
PMP certification, PMI equivalent credential/training, or blackbelt/greenbelt certification.
Big-picture thinking with the ability to distill detailed processes and workflows into clear strategy.
Entrepreneurial mindset with attention to detail.
Physical Requirements & Working Conditions:
This position will require time shared between an office and brewery/manufacturing plant environment. Working conditions may include loud noises, extreme temperatures, and enclosed spaces. Must wear Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) including safety glasses, hair nets, ear plugs, and steel toe boots (as required by company policy).

cond_0294.intro: We are looking for a Senior Manufacturing and Process Engineer to join our team at [Company name masked] in [Location masked]. In this role you will provide daily support to Brewing, Packaging, Operations and Maintenance to keep all aspects of production running correctly and efficiently. You will regularly connect with the brewery leadership team and work closely with internal and external partners to lead manufacturing and process improvement initiatives from development through implementation, covering productivity, capacity, quality, safety, and compliance. This position suits someone comfortable in a sometimes unstructured environment who is willing to roll up their sleeves and stay actively engaged across all parts of the business.
cond_0294.responsibilities:
Develop, implement, and manage a lean manufacturing engineering program across all operations.
Regularly collaborate with the brewery leadership team to identify, develop, and lead process improvement and engineering initiatives to increase efficiency, safety, quality, and productivity.
Establish and maintain supporting infrastructure, MRO process, inventory, vendor relationships, documentation systems, and preventative maintenance capabilities.
Prepare project scopes, capital cost estimates, and cost value analyses, and stay in close contact with Finance and other relevant parties to strategize, plan, and deploy capital effectively.
Develop schedules, work breakdown structures, deliverables, budgets, and resource plans.
Manage and execute projects on schedule and within budget across the entire lifecycle (install, commission, controls, instrumentation, SCADA/MES/ERP).
Manage and supervise related contract work schedules, quality, and performance.
Implement robust PM, PdM, and MOH maintenance plans for all new equipment overseen.
Drive part, machine, and operator proficiency and consistency of the production lines to minimize shift and production variance.
Apply various programming languages for the SCADA system, including programming PLCs and the interface software (Ignition).
Develop and review technical documents (e.g., blueprints, schematics, P&IDs).
Work directly with Production and Maintenance teams to troubleshoot and resolve technical problems during production operations.
Manage multiple projects and communicate progress clearly to relevant stakeholders.
Assist in achieving department KPIs, business, and production goals.
Over time, develop standardized programs, KPIs/metrics, and reports to ensure process operating performance, ongoing improvements, risk identification, visibility, and training.
Develop operational performance dashboards and actively present findings in key forums to keep teams informed on system health.
Troubleshoot systems as required; perform failure analysis and implement preventive methods to improve performance.
Ensure alarms and controls identify and resolve issues systemically.
Raise maintenance team skillset, workflow, and competency through regular coaching and mentoring.
Seek out opportunities to improve capacity, eliminate waste, improve sustainability, and heighten team safety, camaraderie, and fun.
Occasional travel required to support projects.
cond_0294.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, or Manufacturing Engineering.
8+ Years of experience in beverage manufacturing, brewing, or related process industries.
Demonstrated results developing and deploying CAPEX projects, managing complex engineering projects and large capital budgets in a manufacturing environment.
Proficiency in engineering and reliability toolsets: CAD, SCADA (Ignition preferred), PLCs, controls hardware, Pareto analysis, FMEA, RCM, and RCA.
Experience with CMMS, ERP, and MES production and inventory management systems.
Proficiency with project management tools including AutoCAD and Microsoft Project.
Deep understanding of lean manufacturing.
Financial acumen and proficiency with CAPEX budgeting and reporting.
Strong communicator who is comfortable explaining trade-offs, walking stakeholders through decisions, and handling questions directly.
Preferred Requirements
Experience with brewhouse, cellar, and packaging equipment.
PMP certification, PMI equivalent credential/training, and blackbelt or greenbelt certification.
Big-picture thinker who can also get into the details of tactical processes and workflows.
Able to manage multiple projects, prioritize, and stay in regular contact with teams across a busy, varied workload.

cond_0446.intro: We are looking for an experienced Senior Manufacturing and Process Engineer to join our team at [Company name masked] in [Location masked]. In this role you will provide daily support to Brewing, Packaging, Operations and Maintenance to ensure all aspects of production are operating correctly and efficiently. You will lead manufacturing and process improvement initiatives from development through implementation to increase productivity, capacity, improve quality, safety and ensure compliance. This position is ideal for someone who is comfortable working in a sometimes unstructured environment and willing to roll up their sleeves and support all aspects of the business. People usually grow into this role over time as they build experience with manufacturing and process engineering work.
cond_0446.responsibilities:
Develop, implement and manage a lean manufacturing engineering program across all operations.
Collaborate with the brewery leadership team to identify, develop and lead process improvement and engineering initiatives to increase efficiency, safety, quality and productivity.
Establish and maintain supporting infrastructure, MRO process, inventory, vendor relationships, documentation systems and preventative maintenance capabilities.
Prepare project scopes, capital cost estimates, cost value analyses, and collaborate with relevant parties, including Finance, to strategize, plan and deploy capital effectively.
Develop schedules, work break down structures, deliverables, budget and resource plans.
Manage and execute projects, on schedule and within budget across the entire lifecycle (install, commission, controls, instrumentation, SCADA/MES/ERP).
Manage and supervise related contract work schedules, quality, and performance.
Implement robust PM, PdM, and MOH maintenance plans for all new equipment overseen.
Drive the part, machine and operator proficiency and consistency of the production lines to minimize shift and production variance.
Apply various programming languages necessary for utilizing the SCADA system including programming PLCs (programmable logic controllers) and the interface software (Ignition).
Develop/review technical documents (e.g., blueprints, schematics, P&IDs, etc.)
Assist Production and Maintenance Departments in repairing technical problems during production operations.
Effectively manage multiple projects and work independently with minimal supervision.
Assist in achieving department KPIs, business and production goals.
Over time, develop standardized programs, KPIs/metrics and reports to ensure process operating performance, ongoing improvements, risk identification, visibility and training.
Develop operational performance dashboards to report on health of the systems.
Drive and/or support the planning and execution of reviews and present in key forums to support the above.
Troubleshoot systems as required.
Perform failure analysis and implement preventive methods to improve performance.
Ensure alarms and controls identify and resolve issues systemically.
Raise maintenance team skillset, workflow and competency.
Mentor/coach employees within the department related to improvements or projects.
Seek out all opportunities to improve capacity, eliminate waste, improve sustainability and heighten team safety, comradery and fun.
Occasional travel required to support projects.
cond_0446.requirements:
Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial or Manufacturing Engineering.
8+ Years of experience in beverage manufacturing, brewing or related process industries.
Experience with brewhouse, cellar and packaging equipment is preferred.
Demonstrated results in developing and deploying CAPEX projects- managing complex engineering projects and large capital budgets in a manufacturing environment.
Proficiency in engineering and reliability toolsets- CAD, SCADA (Ignition preferred), PLCs, controls hardware, Pareto analysis, Failure Modes and Effects Analysis (FMEA), Reliability Centered Maintenance (RCM), and Root Cause Analysis (RCA).
Experience with CMMS, ERP, MES production and inventory management systems.
Proficiency with project management tools including AutoCAD, Microsoft Project.
Deep understanding of lean manufacturing.
PMP certification, PMI equivalent credential/training and blackbelt or greenbelt certification desired.
Financial acumen and proficiency with CAPEX budgeting and reporting.
Entrepreneurial, astute, has a passion for getting into the details.
Big picture thinker, strategic and able to distill tactical/detailed process and workflows.
Must be a self-starter with the ability to juggle multiple projects, prioritize, and execute.
An effective and persuasive communicator with outstanding presence and presentation skills.
This position will require time shared between an office and Brewery/Manufacturing plant environment. Working conditions may include loud noises, extreme temperatures, enclosed spaces. Must wear Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) including safety glasses, hair nets, ear plugs and steel toe boots (as required by company policy).

Manage multiple projects and communicate progress clearly to relevant stakeholders.
Assist in achieving department KPIs, business, and production goals.

Develop operational performance dashboards and actively present findings in key forums to keep teams informed on system health.
Troubleshoot systems as required; perform failure analysis and implement preventive methods to improve performance.
Ensure alarms and controls identify and resolve issues systemically.
Raise maintenance team skillset, workflow, and competency through regular coaching and mentoring.
